reserves.name: nTBILL Treasury-vault portfolio (JTRSY, USTB, and stablecoin liquidity)
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Nest Treasury Vault and the Janus Henderson Anemoy Treasury Fund / Superstate USTB issuers

reserveReview.rationale: Nest's current asset directory identifies JTRSY and USTB as assets used in nTBILL, while the nTBILL guide identifies the Nest Treasury Vault and its USDC/pUSD deposit and redemption rails. The reviewed public pages do not publish current weights for the fund positions or the stablecoin liquidity sleeve, so the former 82.2% / 17% / 0.8% split was not retained.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Nest underlying-asset directory and nTBILL integration disclosures
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The portfolio categories and named fund positions are identified, but current allocation weights, stablecoin-buffer composition, and custody-provider shares are not published in the reviewed sources.
